title: LLM Client Integration & Management
summary: This module provides core interfaces for integrating with various Language Models (LLMs), including a base class for custom LLM clients, LiteLLM-based wrappers for external APIs, and utilities for managing and finetuning local LLMs. It also includes a dummy LM for testing purposes.

nodes.label: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.title: dspy.clients.base_lm.BaseLM
nodes.description: Defines a common interface for all Language Models, handling request processing, history, and response parsing.

nodes.label: Synchronous LiteLLM Chat Completion
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm.litellm_completion
nodes.description: Handles synchronous chat completion requests using the LiteLLM library, including caching and retries.

nodes.label: Asynchronous LiteLLM Chat Completion
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm.alitellm_completion
nodes.description: Handles asynchronous chat completion requests using the LiteLLM library, including caching and retries.

nodes.label: Synchronous LiteLLM Structured Responses
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm.litellm_responses_completion
nodes.description: Processes synchronous requests for structured outputs via LiteLLM's responses API.

nodes.label: Asynchronous LiteLLM Structured Responses
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm.alitellm_responses_completion
nodes.description: Processes asynchronous requests for structured outputs via LiteLLM's responses API.

nodes.label: Synchronous LiteLLM Text Completion
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm.litellm_text_completion
nodes.description: Manages synchronous text completion requests through LiteLLM, converting chat messages to text prompts.

nodes.label: Asynchronous LiteLLM Text Completion
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm.alitellm_text_completion
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous text completion requests through LiteLLM, converting chat messages to text prompts.

nodes.label: Local LLM Provider Management
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm_local.LocalProvider
nodes.description: Enables launching, managing, and finetuning local Language Models using SGLang.

nodes.label: Dummy Language Model for Testing
nodes.title: dspy.utils.dummies.DummyLM
nodes.description: A mock LLM implementation used for unit testing, returning predefined or example-based responses.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Library / External LLM APIs
nodes.title: LiteLLM Integration
nodes.description: The LiteLLM library and the various external LLM APIs it integrates with (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).

nodes.label: SGLang Local LLM Server
nodes.title: SGLang Server
nodes.description: A local server instance powered by SGLang, used for running and serving local LLMs.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.title: dspy.settings
nodes.description: Provides global configuration and settings for DSPy components, including history management.

nodes.label: DSPy Callback System
nodes.title: dspy.utils.callback
nodes.description: Allows for custom logic execution at various points during LLM interactions, such as logging or monitoring.

nodes.label: DSPy Output Adapters
nodes.title: dspy.adapters
nodes.description: Formats LLM outputs into structured data types or specific message formats.

nodes.label: Local Filesystem
nodes.title: Local Storage
nodes.description: Storage for local LLM models, training data, and finetuning outputs.

nodes.label: LLM Training Job Definition
nodes.title: dspy.clients.lm_local.TrainingJob
nodes.description: Defines parameters and configurations for finetuning LLMs, used by local providers.
